:::{#exr-rss-deriv-slope}
#### Derivative of RSS with respect to the slope

Find the partial derivative of the simple linear regression
residual sum of squares $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to the slope, $\partial \text{RSS} / \partial \coef{x}$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-rss-deriv-slope}

By the chain rule applied to each term of the sum:

$$
\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \coef{x}}
= \sumin 2 (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)
  \frac{\partial}{\partial \coef{x}} (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i).
$$

The inner derivative:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial}{\partial \coef{x}} (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)
&= \frac{\partial y_i}{\partial \coef{x}}
  - \frac{\partial \intcoef}{\partial \coef{x}}
  - \frac{\partial (\coef{x} x_i)}{\partial \coef{x}}
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= 0 - 0 - x_i
&& \text{($y_i$ and $\intcoef$ do not depend on $\coef{x}$)}\\
&= -x_i
\end{aligned}
$$

Plugging the inner derivative back in:

$$
\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \coef{x}}
= -2 \sumin x_i (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i).
$$

:::
